sections.overview: Pithecheirops otion is a little-known murid rodent from Sabah, Malaysian Borneo, and the sole described species of its genus.
sections.identification: It was originally described from a single specimen, and its distinguishing anatomy includes features of the middle-ear region and skull.
sections.habitat: The sole museum specimen came from Danum Valley; later sightings there suggest the species persists.
sections.behavior: The original account described it as arboreal, but its daily habits remain largely unknown.
sections.ecology: Genetic evidence places Pithecheirops as the sister genus of Pithecheir.
sections.conservation: Few records leave its abundance and conservation needs uncertain.
